title: The sample list
text: You are a sample officer in a sample office. A sample benefit must reach sample families within a week.
A sample visitor brings a list and asks that it be paid first. Your sample check shows some names on it are not eligible.
The visitor hints at trouble for you if there is any delay.
asks: What options do you have? Weigh each.
What will you do, and why?

issues.v: need, not who sent the list

options.t: Sample option: pay the list now
Sample option: pay checked families now, check the rest fast

key.decision: Sample decision: pay the checked families today and check the list within two days.
key.system: Sample fix: publish the checked list where everyone can see it.
